world_org_meetings.title: Search under way for four soldiers missing after gang attack in Haiti
world_org_meetings.description: The UN Security Council holds a meeting on Haiti; the attack on UN-backed forces is expected to dominate the discussions.

world_org_meetings.title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy speaks at EU summit amid spat with Donald Trump
world_org_meetings.description: EU leaders reaffirmed support for Ukraine at the Brussels summit. But souring relations with the US over Russia and Starlink and a big hole in the budget will make for a difficult winter for Ukraine.

world_org_meetings.title: Zelensky hails "real leaders" in Europe, blasts Trump's diesel deal with Russia
world_org_meetings.description: Ukrainian ​President Volodymyr Zelensky took aim on Friday at US President Donald Trump's diesel deal with Russia and welcomed the prospect of European allies stepping up their role in talks, calling Moscow's stance a "parody" of peace negotiations. At a European Union summit in Brussels, Zelenskiy said Russia did not want peace. He added that Ukraine was still experiencing disruptions to the SpaceX Starshield satellite system. FRANCE 24's Europe Editor Armen Georgian reports from Brussels.

world_org_meetings.title: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
world_org_meetings.description: EU leaders meeting in Brussels will examine measures to curb the bloc's huge trade deficit with China. But they will also be looking to further agreement on the next EU budget ahead of some major elections next year.

world_org_meetings.title: G20 finance ministers, central bankers gather amid fallout from Iran war
world_org_meetings.description: Officials meet in Thailand as conflict drives energy prices higher and casts uncertainty over global economy.

diplomatic_visits.title: Macron secures diesel deals on Gulf visit as fuel prices stoke unrest in France
diplomatic_visits.description: French President Emmanuel Macron has obtained commitments to deliver an additional 200,000 tonnes of diesel per month from the United Arab Emirates and Bahrain during a tour of the Gulf, his office said Tuesday as the French government scrambles to address a cost-of-living crisis that has fuelled unrest in the country.

diplomatic_visits.title: Uzbekistan's $12bn business drive gathers pace during Rubio visit
diplomatic_visits.description: The package covers railways, critical minerals, finance and technology, with major US firms involved. Uzbek President Mirziyoyev outlined measures to attract investors, while business executives told Euronews that commercial activity is growing.

diplomatic_visits.title: Rubio arrives in Samarkand as Washington seeks closer ties with Central Asia
diplomatic_visits.description: The US secretary of state will meet the foreign ministers of five Central Asian countries on Monday under the C5+1 format. Trade, investment, critical minerals and security are expected to feature in discussions, while more than 200 American business executives accompany the visit.

diplomatic_visits.title: Russia-China-US summit would prolong the war, Kyiv says
diplomatic_visits.description: Ukrainian ⁠Foreign Minister ​Andrii Sybiha said on ​Monday that a summit between Russia, China ​and the ‌US would ⁠encourage President Vladimir Putin ‌to prolong the war. The ​Wall Street Journal reported that Putin had proposed a ​summit next month ​with US ​President Donald Trump and Chinese President ​Xi Jinping to negotiate an end to the war on terms ⁠that would favour Moscow. FRANCE 24's Monte Francis reports.

diplomatic_visits.title: Hungarian PM Péter Magyar says Zelenskyy unlikely to visit Budapest later this month
diplomatic_visits.description: Zelenskyy's deputy chief of staff told Euronews earlier this week that the Ukrainian leader had been invited to Budapest on 23 October, to join events commemorating the 70th anniversary of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution.

elections.title: Why Israeli Gen Z voters are drawn to the far right
elections.description: More than half a million young people will cast their ballots in Israel next week - and they could make all the difference.

elections.title: Personal attacks fire up debate before Brazil's run-off vote
elections.description: The race heats up just days before the run-off between the left-wing incumbent and his right-wing challenger.

elections.title: Albertans vote on path to independence as Carney fights to keep Canada united
elections.description: Voters in Canada’s oil-rich Alberta province will decide Monday whether to begin a process that could lead to independence, testing national unity

elections.title: Canada: Alberta votes on holding independence referendum
elections.description: Canada's oil-rich western province of Alberta is not deemed likely to vote in favor of a real breakaway plebiscite. Nevertheless the separatist movement hopes to gain leverage over Mark Carney's government.

elections.title: Lula supporters spell out his name in Rio waters before Brazil runoff
elections.description: Brazil’s Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro clash in a tense debate over public spending, corruption and ties to the US, as polls show a tight 51–49 race.
